responsibility: Emulates the `__cpuid_count` x86 arch intrinsic for the Cranelift backend by synthesizing fixed CPUID register results in Cranelift IR for the small set of leaves this backend supports. It models a minimal Intel-like CPU feature surface used by intrinsic lowering, returning vendor and SSE/SSE2 capability information for recognized leaves and trapping when code requests unsupported CPUID leaves.
